dedupe_keys.name: mobilfunk antennen standorte mobile mast locations for the wurzburg area opencellid extract

description: This dataset on the Würzburg open data portal lists locations of mobile masts for a section of the city and the surrounding district (bounding box about 9.72 to 10.15 degrees east and 49.72 to 49.87 degrees north), taken from OpenCelliD, a community project in which users collect GPS positions of cell towers. Fields include latitude, longitude, mobile country and network codes, location area code, cell identifier, radio type, average signal strength, range and sample count, as documented in the field descriptions. The portal reports 1,242 records. Producer: the city of Würzburg republishes the data; OpenCelliD estimates positions from user measurements. Coverage: the city and district of Würzburg, Germany. Access: browse or export on the portal or call the Explore API. Licence and cost: free; the description says the data are published under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence, while the portal's licence field is empty. Caveats: the first records returned by the API contain null and implausible values (a latitude of 5000), so the extract needs cleaning, and positions are estimates, not operator records. Simulation uses: mast positions can seed local coverage and capacity models. Related records: OpenCelliD (data-opencellid) and the CellMapper crowdsourced tower map (data-cellmapper-crowdsourced-cell-tower-map).
